name: policy-uri-is-a-relative-reference
description: policy_uri is a uri-reference rather than the absolute URI the schema asks for. No network is needed to see it: this is a defect in the record, and it is reported the same way with or without a resolver.
defect: reference is relative, not the absolute URI the schema asks for

anchor.text: URI to the policy bundle for verification.
anchor.applies: The schema asks for format: uri, which is the absolute form. A reference the record got wrong is a defect in the record, visible with no network. This is a conformance statement about the packaged schema, not a claim about the specification, which says nothing about policy_uri at all.

expected.reason: A relative reference names no authority, so no verifier can dereference it on its own.
